content.title: Chapter 90 - SOLID WASTE — Sec. 90-61. - Responsibilities of licensee.
content.summary:
The holder of a license under this article shall have the sole burden and responsibility
               of disposing of waste collected and shall hold the city harmless should any claim
               be made regarding the collection or disposal thereof.
(Ord. No.
4733
, § 1, 6-15-2020)
